definitions.explanation: Inside a political party; used of a party's internal affairs, factions, debates and elections.

examples.japanese: {党内|とうない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}れた→割れる：00907_wareru⟧。
examples.english: Opinion within the party was divided.

examples.japanese: {党内|とうない}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: A new leader was chosen in the party's internal election.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{党内|とうない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}えられ→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧ず、⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見送|みおく}った→見送る：04240_miokuru⟧。
examples.english: Unable to contain opposition within the party, the prime minister put off submitting the bill.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {党内|とうない}⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧: conflict within the party
- {党内|とうない}⟦{基盤|きばん}→基盤：00220_kiban⟧: one's support base within the party
- {党内|とうない}⟦{融和|ゆうわ}→融和：09130_yuuwa⟧: party unity
- {党内|とうない}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧: an internal party election

RELATED WORDS:
- {党外|とうがい}: outside the party
- ⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧: ruling party
- ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧: opposition party
- ⟦{派閥|はばつ}→派閥：16960_habatsu⟧: faction
